text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, Trainer!
You're a person of your word, truly impressive.
choice_data_list: ...I was actually planning to get a thousand of them, though...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, no, one is plenty.
Besides, it really didn't fit that much in the first place.
choice_data_list: If only I had taken off the leg restraints, I would have made it...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What the heck are you wearing?! And besides,
if it's on your legs, it won't even affect your playing, right?
choice_data_list: Start over from the 12th practice swing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why are you practice-swinging now?!
And your swing count is ridiculously low!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What am I gonna do with you?
Every time I look at this kid, I feel like I'm gonna burst out laughin'.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
People might get suspicious if they see it with me.
So please, let me keep this child in the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It won't be a problem if you laugh over there.
